Marcus —

Thanks for the note and attachments. Quick legal checklist from our side:

- For the MSA we need either (a) corporate secretary signature + CEO, or (b) a board resolution/POA that authorizes a named officer to sign on behalf of the company. Without that, procurement at some customers flags the MSA as needing notarization.

- Order Form can often be signed by an authorized business lead with delegated signing authority — if Lumen confirms delegated authority for the OF we can route OF-tier to a single signer and keep the MSA for two-step execution.

- If Lumen’s GC requires countersignature on the MSA PDF (post-signature), we can set DocuSign to notify and require an in-person wet-sign hold, but that will add ~2 business days. Avoid if possible.

Action items for Lumen (cc Sarah/legal): please confirm the signers and attach a brief evidence doc (board cert/POA/authorization letter) for the person(s) signing the MSA. If you already have something, you can upload to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LumenMSA-ExecDocs

Once we have the authority doc I’ll prepare two envelopes:
- Envelope A (MSA): sequential routing — primary signer (CEO), corporate secretary (if required), QC step to internal legal for final review, then notify Lumen GC.
- Envelope B (Order Form): parallel with delegated signer, automatic clean-copy delivery to both parties and to Redwood Contracts (contracts@redwood.com).

Laura Bennett
